discription: A plucky bass sound using a sawtooth wave with a short decay envelope for a punchy attack.
code: { arg out=0, freq=70, amp=0.2, gate=1; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.005, 0.1, 0.3, 0.3, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = Saw.ar(freq) * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
